```{r install-packages, eval=FALSE}
#------------------------------------
# STEP 0: Install packages
#------------------------------------

options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"))

cran_packages <- c(
  "Seurat",
  "SeuratObject",
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "stringr",
  "purrr",
  "readr",
  "ggplot2",
  "patchwork",
  "future",
  "remotes",
  "devtools"
)

bioconductor_packages <- c(
  "BiocGenerics",
  "DelayedArray",
  "DelayedMatrixStats",
  "limma",
  "lme4",
  "batchelor",
  "SingleCellExperiment",
  "SummarizedExperiment",
  "S4Vectors",
  "ggrastr"
)

install.packages(cran_packages)
install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install(
  bioconductor_packages,
  ask = FALSE,
  update = FALSE
)

# Monocle3 1.0.0 depends on two older CRAN packages. Install archived dependencies before Monocle3.
remotes::install_version(
  "grr",
  version = "0.9.5",
  repos = "https://cran.r-project.org",
  upgrade = "never"
)

remotes::install_version(
  "Matrix.utils",
  version = "0.9.8",
  repos = "https://cran.r-project.org",
  upgrade = "never"
)

# Monocle3 1.0.0 is the BEAR-compatible trajectory version used
remotes::install_github(
  "cole-trapnell-lab/monocle3",
  ref = "1.0.0",
  upgrade = "never"
)

library(monocle3)

```

```{r}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 1: Clear environment and set parameters
#-----------------------------------------------

rm(list = ls())
gc()

# Paths and output names
project_name <- "GSE324208_scRNA_bulk_trajectory_analysis"
working_dir <- "/rds/projects/g/gendood-bioinfohub/Thesis_LH"

# Input from bulk Seurat workflow.
seurat_analysis_dir <- "GSE324208_scRNA_bulk_analysis"

# Trajectory output folder.
out_dir <- project_name

# Restrict to tumour/stromal/adipogenic states. Thus immune and endothelial lineages do not distort the trajectory
trajectory_labels <- c(
  "LPS_tumour_cells",
  "Sarcoma",
  "Adipogenic_like_fibroblasts",
  "Adipocytes",
  "Cancer_associated_fibroblasts",
  "Fibroblasts",
  "ECM_remodelling_fibroblasts",
  "Perivascular_fibroblasts",
  "Smooth_muscle_cells"
)

# Rooting starts from adipogenic/fibroblast-like states and tests progression towards tumour-like/proliferative states.
root_state_priority <- c(
  "Adipogenic_like_fibroblasts",
  "Adipocytes",
  "Fibroblasts",
  "Cancer_associated_fibroblasts",
  "ECM_remodelling_fibroblasts"
)

# All trajectory cells are retained. 
use_all_selected_trajectory_cells <- TRUE
minimum_cells_per_state <- 50L
maximum_root_cells <- 200L
monocle_num_dim <- 30L
trajectory_hvgs <- 1000L
graph_test_cores <- 1L
trajectory_marker_q_threshold <- 0.05

# Keep graph_test below 10,000 cells to avoid the Monocle3 principal_graph rbind error
graph_test_max_cells <- 9999L

# Use Seurat Harmony UMAP when present.
use_existing_seurat_umap <- TRUE

# FALSE learns one graph across selected cells. Set TRUE if the selected cells are visibly disconnected and should not be forced into one trajectory.
learn_graph_use_partition <- FALSE

# If graph test is slow, set to FALSE
run_graph_test <- TRUE

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 4: Load the annotated bulk Seurat object
#-----------------------------------------------

object_candidates <- c(
  file.path(
    seurat_objects_final_dir,
    "GSE324208_manual_SingleR_ScType_compared_object.rds"
  ),
  file.path(
    seurat_objects_final_dir,
    "GSE324208_after_HPCA_ScType_annotation.rds"
  ),
  file.path(
    seurat_objects_integrated_dir,
    "GSE324208_selected_clustered_object.rds"
  )
)

input_object_file <- object_candidates[file.exists(object_candidates)][1]

if (is.na(input_object_file)) {
  stop(
    "No annotated Seurat object was found. Expected one of:\n",
    paste(object_candidates, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

seurat_full <- readRDS(input_object_file)
DefaultAssay(seurat_full) <- "RNA"

annotation_candidates <- c(
  "manual_annotation",
  "final_exact_marker_annotation",
  "ScType_exact_marker_column",
  "SingleR_HPCA_label",
  "SingleR_exact_marker_column"
)

annotation_column <- annotation_candidates[
  annotation_candidates %in% colnames(seurat_full[[]])
][1]

if (is.na(annotation_column)) {
  stop(
    "No supported annotation column was found. Expected one of: ",
    paste(annotation_candidates, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (!"sample_id" %in% colnames(seurat_full[[]])) {
  seurat_full$sample_id <- as.character(seurat_full$orig.ident)
}

if (!"condition" %in% colnames(seurat_full[[]])) {
  stop("The Seurat object does not contain a condition column.")
}

cat("Input object:", input_object_file, "\n")
cat("Cells:", ncol(seurat_full), "\n")
cat("Genes:", nrow(seurat_full), "\n")
cat("Annotation column:", annotation_column, "\n")

print(sort(table(seurat_full[[annotation_column]][, 1]), decreasing = TRUE))

```


```{r}
#------------------------------------
# STEP 5: Select trajectory cells
#------------------------------------

available_labels <- sort(
  unique(as.character(seurat_full[[annotation_column]][, 1]))
)

trajectory_labels_present <- intersect(
  trajectory_labels,
  available_labels
)

if (length(trajectory_labels_present) < 2) {
  stop(
    "Fewer than two requested trajectory labels are present. Present labels: ",
    paste(trajectory_labels_present, collapse = ", "),
    ". Edit trajectory_labels before continuing."
  )
}

trajectory_metadata <- seurat_full[[]] %>%
  select(-any_of("cell")) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  mutate(
    trajectory_state = as.character(.data[[annotation_column]]),
    sample_id = as.character(sample_id),
    condition = as.character(condition)
  ) %>%
  filter(trajectory_state %in% trajectory_labels_present)

state_counts_before <- trajectory_metadata %>%
  count(condition, trajectory_state, name = "n_cells") %>%
  arrange(condition, desc(n_cells))

state_counts_total <- trajectory_metadata %>%
  count(trajectory_state, name = "n_cells") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_cells))

if (any(state_counts_total$n_cells < minimum_cells_per_state)) {
  warning(
    "One or more selected trajectory states contains fewer than ",
    minimum_cells_per_state,
    " cells. Interpret small states cautiously."
  )
}

trajectory_cells <- trajectory_metadata$cell

lineage_seurat <- subset(
  seurat_full,
  cells = trajectory_cells
)

lineage_seurat$trajectory_state <- as.character(
  lineage_seurat[[annotation_column]][, 1]
)

trajectory_sampling_table <- lineage_seurat[[]] %>%
  select(-any_of("cell")) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  count(
    condition,
    sample_id,
    trajectory_state,
    name = "n_cells"
  ) %>%
  arrange(condition, sample_id, trajectory_state)

write_csv(
  state_counts_before,
  file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_selected_state_counts.csv")
)

write_csv(
  trajectory_sampling_table,
  file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_cells_retained_by_sample_and_state.csv")
)

cat(
  "Trajectory labels present:",
  paste(trajectory_labels_present, collapse = ", "),
  "\n"
)
cat("Trajectory cells retained:", ncol(lineage_seurat), "\n")

print(sort(table(lineage_seurat$trajectory_state), decreasing = TRUE))

rm(seurat_full, trajectory_metadata)
if (exists("trajectory_strata")) {
  rm(trajectory_strata)
}
gc()

```

```{r}
seurat_umap <- if ("umap.harmony" %in% Reductions(lineage_seurat)) {
```

```{r}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 7: Construct a Monocle 3 cell_data_set
#-----------------------------------------------

counts_matrix <- tryCatch(
  GetAssayData(lineage_seurat, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"),
  error = function(e) {
    GetAssayData(lineage_seurat, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
  }
)

cell_metadata <- lineage_seurat[[]]

gene_metadata <- data.frame(
  gene_short_name = rownames(counts_matrix),
  row.names = rownames(counts_matrix),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cds <- monocle3::new_cell_data_set(
  expression_data = counts_matrix,
  cell_metadata = cell_metadata,
  gene_metadata = gene_metadata
)

cds <- monocle3::detect_genes(cds, min_expr = 0.1)

minimum_gene_cells <- max(10L, ceiling(0.01 * ncol(cds)))
genes_detected <- rowData(cds)$num_cells_expressed >= minimum_gene_cells
genes_detected[is.na(genes_detected)] <- FALSE
cds <- cds[genes_detected, ]

cat("Monocle CDS cells:", ncol(cds), "\n")
cat("Monocle CDS genes retained:", nrow(cds), "\n")

rm(counts_matrix, cell_metadata, gene_metadata)
gc()

```


```{r}
#-----------------------------------------------------
# STEP 8: Preprocess, reduce dimensions and cluster
#-----------------------------------------------------

num_dim_use <- min(
  monocle_num_dim,
  ncol(cds) - 1L,
  nrow(cds) - 1L
)

if (num_dim_use < 2L) {
  stop("Too few cells or genes are available for Monocle PCA.")
}

cds <- monocle3::preprocess_cds(
  cds,
  method = "PCA",
  num_dim = num_dim_use,
  norm_method = "log",
  verbose = FALSE
)

if (use_existing_seurat_umap && !is.na(seurat_umap)) {
  seurat_umap_coordinates <- Embeddings(
    lineage_seurat,
    reduction = seurat_umap
  )

  seurat_umap_coordinates <- seurat_umap_coordinates[
    colnames(cds),
    1:2,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  colnames(seurat_umap_coordinates) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
  reducedDims(cds)$UMAP <- seurat_umap_coordinates
} else {
  cds <- monocle3::reduce_dimension(
    cds,
    reduction_method = "UMAP",
    preprocess_method = "PCA",
    umap.metric = "cosine",
    verbose = FALSE
  )
}

monocle_k <- min(20L, ncol(cds) - 1L)

cds <- monocle3::cluster_cells(
  cds,
  reduction_method = "UMAP",
  k = monocle_k,
  verbose = FALSE
)

cat("Monocle clusters:", length(unique(monocle3::clusters(cds))), "\n")
cat("Monocle partitions:", length(unique(monocle3::partitions(cds))), "\n")

```


```{r}
#--------------------------------------
# STEP 9: Learn the principal graph
#--------------------------------------

graph_ncenter <- min(
  ncol(cds),
  300L,
  max(30L, floor(ncol(cds) / 10L))
)

cds <- monocle3::learn_graph(
  cds,
  use_partition = learn_graph_use_partition,
  close_loop = FALSE,
  learn_graph_control = list(
    ncenter = graph_ncenter
  ),
  verbose = FALSE
)

partition_vector <- monocle3::partitions(cds)
names(partition_vector) <- colnames(cds)

partition_state_table <- data.frame(
  cell = colnames(cds),
  partition = as.character(partition_vector),
  trajectory_state = as.character(colData(cds)$trajectory_state),
  condition = as.character(colData(cds)$condition),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  count(partition, condition, trajectory_state, name = "n_cells") %>%
  arrange(partition, condition, trajectory_state)

write_csv(
  partition_state_table,
  file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_partition_state_counts.csv")
)

```


```{r}
#-------------------------------------------
# STEP 10: Select a root and order cells
#-------------------------------------------

root_state <- root_state_priority[
  root_state_priority %in% unique(colData(cds)$trajectory_state)
][1]

if (is.na(root_state)) {
  stop(
    "None of the configured root states is present. Edit root_state_priority."
  )
}

root_pool <- colnames(cds)[
  as.character(colData(cds)$trajectory_state) == root_state
]

if (learn_graph_use_partition) {
  root_partition <- names(
    sort(
      table(as.character(partition_vector[root_pool])),
      decreasing = TRUE
    )
  )[1]

  root_pool <- root_pool[
    as.character(partition_vector[root_pool]) == root_partition
  ]
} else {
  root_partition <- "single_graph"
}

if (length(root_pool) == 0) {
  stop("No root cells were available after root-state filtering.")
}

set.seed(42)
root_cells <- sample(
  root_pool,
  size = min(maximum_root_cells, length(root_pool)),
  replace = FALSE
)

cds <- monocle3::order_cells(
  cds,
  reduction_method = "UMAP",
  root_cells = root_cells,
  verbose = FALSE
)

pseudotime_vector <- monocle3::pseudotime(cds)
pseudotime_vector[!is.finite(pseudotime_vector)] <- NA_real_

root_summary <- data.frame(
  root_state = root_state,
  root_partition = root_partition,
  n_root_cells = length(root_cells),
  n_ordered_cells = sum(!is.na(pseudotime_vector)),
  n_unordered_cells = sum(is.na(pseudotime_vector)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

write_csv(
  root_summary,
  file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_root_selection_summary.csv")
)

print(root_summary)

```


```{r}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 11: Plot trajectory and pseudotime
#-----------------------------------------------

umap_coordinates <- as.data.frame(reducedDims(cds)$UMAP[, 1:2])
colnames(umap_coordinates) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
umap_coordinates$cell <- rownames(umap_coordinates)

cell_metadata_for_plot <- as.data.frame(colData(cds)) %>%
  select(any_of(c("trajectory_state", "condition", "sample_id"))) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell")

trajectory_plot_data <- umap_coordinates %>%
  left_join(cell_metadata_for_plot, by = "cell") %>%
  mutate(monocle3_pseudotime = unname(pseudotime_vector[cell]))

principal_graph_object <- monocle3::principal_graph(cds)[["UMAP"]]
principal_graph_coordinates <- cds@principal_graph_aux[["UMAP"]]$dp_mst

if (nrow(principal_graph_coordinates) == 2) {
  principal_graph_nodes <- as.data.frame(t(principal_graph_coordinates))
} else {
  principal_graph_nodes <- as.data.frame(principal_graph_coordinates[, 1:2])
}

principal_graph_nodes <- principal_graph_nodes[, 1:2]
colnames(principal_graph_nodes) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
principal_graph_nodes <- principal_graph_nodes %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("node")

principal_graph_edges <- igraph::as_data_frame(
  principal_graph_object,
  what = "edges"
) %>%
  select(from, to) %>%
  left_join(principal_graph_nodes, by = c("from" = "node")) %>%
  rename(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2) %>%
  left_join(principal_graph_nodes, by = c("to" = "node")) %>%
  rename(xend = UMAP_1, yend = UMAP_2)

root_pr_nodes <- cds@principal_graph_aux[["UMAP"]]$root_pr_nodes

principal_graph_node_labels <- principal_graph_nodes %>%
  mutate(
    node_degree = as.numeric(igraph::degree(principal_graph_object)[node]),
    node_label = case_when(
      node %in% root_pr_nodes ~ paste0("root\n", node),
      node_degree > 2 ~ paste0("branch\n", node),
      node_degree == 1 ~ paste0("leaf\n", node),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(node_label))

p_trajectory_state <- ggplot(
  trajectory_plot_data,
  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)
) +
  geom_segment(
    data = principal_graph_edges,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "grey30",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = trajectory_state), size = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Monocle 3 bulk trajectory rooted in", root_state),
    x = "UMAP 1",
    y = "UMAP 2",
    colour = "Cell state"
  )

p_trajectory_pseudotime <- ggplot(
  trajectory_plot_data,
  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)
) +
  geom_segment(
    data = principal_graph_edges,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "grey30",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = monocle3_pseudotime), size = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", na.value = "grey85") +
  labs(
    title = "Monocle 3 pseudotime",
    x = "UMAP 1",
    y = "UMAP 2",
    colour = "Pseudotime"
  )

p_trajectory_condition <- ggplot(
  trajectory_plot_data,
  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)
) +
  geom_segment(
    data = principal_graph_edges,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "grey30",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = condition), size = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "WDLPS and DDLPS distribution along the trajectory",
    x = "UMAP 1",
    y = "UMAP 2",
    colour = "Condition"
  )

p_principal_points <- ggplot(
  trajectory_plot_data,
  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)
) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = trajectory_state), size = 0.45, alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_segment(
    data = principal_graph_edges,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "grey20",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = principal_graph_nodes,
    aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = principal_graph_node_labels,
    aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = node_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.7,
    check_overlap = TRUE,
    vjust = -0.6
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Principal graph nodes for root checking",
    x = "UMAP 1",
    y = "UMAP 2",
    colour = "Cell state"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plots_dir,
    "Monocle3_02_trajectory_by_cell_state.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_trajectory_state,
  width = 11,
  height = 8
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plots_dir,
    "Monocle3_03_trajectory_by_pseudotime.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_trajectory_pseudotime,
  width = 11,
  height = 8
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plots_dir,
    "Monocle3_04_trajectory_by_condition.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_trajectory_condition,
  width = 11,

)

ggsave(

    plots_dir,
    "Monocle3_05_principal_graph_nodes.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_principal_points,
  width = 11,
  height = 8
)
```

```{r}
#-----------------------------------------------------
# STEP 12: Export pseudotime and compare conditions
#-----------------------------------------------------

monocle_cluster_vector <- monocle3::clusters(cds)
names(monocle_cluster_vector) <- colnames(cds)

pseudotime_table <- as.data.frame(colData(cds)) %>%
  select(-any_of("cell")) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  mutate(
    monocle3_cluster = as.character(monocle_cluster_vector[cell]),
    monocle3_partition = as.character(partition_vector[cell]),
    monocle3_pseudotime = unname(pseudotime_vector[cell])
  )

write_csv(
  pseudotime_table,
  file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_cell_pseudotime.csv")
)

pseudotime_by_sample <- pseudotime_table %>%
  filter(!is.na(monocle3_pseudotime)) %>%
  group_by(condition, sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells = n(),
    median_pseudotime = median(monocle3_pseudotime),
    mean_pseudotime = mean(monocle3_pseudotime),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pseudotime_by_state_condition <- pseudotime_table %>%
  filter(!is.na(monocle3_pseudotime)) %>%
  group_by(condition, trajectory_state) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells = n(),
    median_pseudotime = median(monocle3_pseudotime),
    mean_pseudotime = mean(monocle3_pseudotime),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(condition, median_pseudotime)

write_csv(
  pseudotime_by_sample,
  file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_pseudotime_by_sample.csv")
)

write_csv(
  pseudotime_by_state_condition,
  file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_pseudotime_by_state_and_condition.csv")
)

# Add pseudotime results back to the seurat object 
lineage_seurat$monocle3_pseudotime <- NA_real_
lineage_seurat$monocle3_partition <- NA_character_
lineage_seurat$monocle3_cluster <- NA_character_

lineage_match <- match(
  colnames(lineage_seurat),
  pseudotime_table$cell
)

lineage_seurat$monocle3_pseudotime <- pseudotime_table$monocle3_pseudotime[
  lineage_match
]

lineage_seurat$monocle3_partition <- pseudotime_table$monocle3_partition[
  lineage_match
]

lineage_seurat$monocle3_cluster <- pseudotime_table$monocle3_cluster[
  lineage_match
]

```


```{r}
#--------------------------------------------------
# STEP 13: Identify trajectory-associated genes
#--------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(marker_file)) {
  stop("Curated marker file was not found: ", marker_file)
}

marker_df <- read_csv(marker_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
marker_columns <- colnames(marker_df)

trajectory_marker_table <- marker_df %>%
  select(all_of(marker_columns)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "marker_column",
    values_to = "gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(gene = str_trim(gene)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "") %>%
  distinct(marker_column, gene) %>%
  filter(gene %in% rownames(cds))

write_csv(
  trajectory_marker_table,
  file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_curated_marker_genes_detected_in_CDS.csv")
)

cat("Curated marker categories:", length(marker_columns), "\n")
cat("Curated marker genes detected in CDS:", n_distinct(trajectory_marker_table$gene), "\n")

if (run_graph_test) {
  # Limit graph_test to highly variable genes to keep memory bounded.
  lineage_seurat <- FindVariableFeatures(
    lineage_seurat,
    assay = "RNA",
    selection.method = "vst",
    nfeatures = min(trajectory_hvgs, nrow(lineage_seurat)),
    verbose = FALSE
  )

  hvg_genes_to_test <- intersect(
    VariableFeatures(lineage_seurat),
    rownames(cds)
  )

  curated_marker_genes_to_test <- unique(trajectory_marker_table$gene)

  genes_to_test <- unique(c(
    hvg_genes_to_test,
    curated_marker_genes_to_test
  ))

  cat("HVGs tested:", length(hvg_genes_to_test), "\n")
  cat("Curated marker genes added/tested:", length(curated_marker_genes_to_test), "\n")
  cat("Total unique genes tested:", length(genes_to_test), "\n")

  graph_test_cells <- colnames(cds)
  graph_test_sampled <- FALSE

  if (ncol(cds) > graph_test_max_cells) {
    set.seed(42)
    graph_test_cells <- sample(graph_test_cells, graph_test_max_cells)
    graph_test_sampled <- TRUE
  }

  graph_test_cell_table <- data.frame(
    cell = graph_test_cells,
    graph_test_sampled = graph_test_sampled,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    left_join(
      as.data.frame(colData(cds)) %>%
        select(any_of(c("trajectory_state", "condition", "sample_id"))) %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("cell"),
      by = "cell"
    )

  write_csv(
    graph_test_cell_table,
    file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_graph_test_cells_used.csv")
  )

  cds_graph_test <- cds[, graph_test_cells]

  cat("graph_test cells used:", ncol(cds_graph_test), "\n")
  cat("graph_test cell sampling applied:", graph_test_sampled, "\n")

  graph_test_results <- tryCatch(
    {
      monocle3::graph_test(
        cds_graph_test[genes_to_test, ],
        neighbor_graph = "principal_graph",
        cores = graph_test_cores,
        verbose = FALSE
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      writeLines(
        c(
          conditionMessage(e),
          "",
          "graph_test_neighbor_graph: principal_graph",
          paste("graph_test_cells:", length(graph_test_cells)),
          paste("graph_test_sampled:", graph_test_sampled),
          paste("graph_test_genes:", length(genes_to_test))
        ),
        file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_graph_test_error.txt")
      )
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(graph_test_results)) {
    graph_test_table <- as.data.frame(graph_test_results) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
      arrange(q_value, desc(morans_I))

    if (!"status" %in% colnames(graph_test_table)) {
      graph_test_table$status <- "OK"
    }

    significant_trajectory_genes <- graph_test_table %>%
      filter(
        status == "OK",
        !is.na(q_value),
        q_value < trajectory_marker_q_threshold,
        morans_I > 0
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(morans_I), q_value)

    write_csv(
      graph_test_table,
      file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_graph_test_all_tested_genes.csv")
    )

    write_csv(
      significant_trajectory_genes,
      file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_trajectory_associated_genes.csv")
    )

    curated_marker_graph_test <- trajectory_marker_table %>%
      inner_join(graph_test_table, by = "gene") %>%
      mutate(
        significant_trajectory_marker = coalesce(status == "OK", FALSE) &
          !is.na(q_value) &
          q_value < trajectory_marker_q_threshold &
          !is.na(morans_I) &
          morans_I > 0
      ) %>%
      arrange(marker_column, q_value, desc(morans_I), gene)

    significant_curated_trajectory_markers <- curated_marker_graph_test %>%
      filter(significant_trajectory_marker) %>%
      arrange(desc(morans_I), q_value, marker_column, gene)

    curated_marker_trajectory_summary <- curated_marker_graph_test %>%
      group_by(marker_column) %>%
      summarise(
        n_markers_tested = n_distinct(gene),
        n_significant_trajectory_markers = n_distinct(
          gene[significant_trajectory_marker]
        ),
        fraction_significant = n_significant_trajectory_markers / n_markers_tested,
        min_q_value = if (all(is.na(q_value))) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          min(q_value, na.rm = TRUE)
        },
        max_morans_I = if (all(is.na(morans_I))) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          max(morans_I, na.rm = TRUE)
        },
        significant_genes = paste(
          unique(gene[significant_trajectory_marker]),
          collapse = ";"
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(n_significant_trajectory_markers), min_q_value, marker_column)

    write_csv(
      curated_marker_graph_test,
      file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_curated_marker_graph_test_all.csv")
    )

    write_csv(
      significant_curated_trajectory_markers,
      file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_significant_curated_trajectory_markers.csv")
    )

    write_csv(
      curated_marker_trajectory_summary,
      file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_curated_marker_trajectory_summary.csv")
    )

    cat("Genes tested:", nrow(graph_test_table), "\n")
    cat(
      "Significant positive-Moran's-I genes:",
      nrow(significant_trajectory_genes),
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "Significant curated trajectory markers:",
      nrow(significant_curated_trajectory_markers),
      "\n"
    )
  } else {
    message(
      "graph_test failed. The error message was saved to ",
      file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_graph_test_error.txt")
    )
  }
} else {
  message("run_graph_test is FALSE, so trajectory-associated gene testing was skipped.")
}
```

```{r}
saveRDS(

    "GSE324208_bulk_trajectory_cells_with_Monocle3_pseudotime.rds"
  )
)

trajectory_parameters <- data.frame(
  input_object = input_object_file,
  annotation_column = annotation_column,
  marker_file = marker_file,
  states_requested = paste(trajectory_labels, collapse = ";"),
  states_present = paste(trajectory_labels_present, collapse = ";"),
  root_state = root_state,
  root_partition = root_partition,
  downsampled = FALSE,
  use_all_selected_trajectory_cells = use_all_selected_trajectory_cells,
  cells_used = ncol(cds),
  genes_used = nrow(cds),
  num_dim = num_dim_use,
  graph_ncenter = graph_ncenter,
  graph_test_genes = ifelse(
    exists("genes_to_test"),
    length(genes_to_test),
    NA_integer_
  ),
  graph_test_max_cells = graph_test_max_cells,
  graph_test_cells_used = if (exists("graph_test_cells")) {
    length(graph_test_cells)
  } else {
    NA_integer_
  },
  graph_test_sampled = if (exists("graph_test_sampled")) {
    graph_test_sampled
  } else {
    NA
  },
  trajectory_marker_q_threshold = trajectory_marker_q_threshold,
  curated_marker_genes_detected = if (exists("trajectory_marker_table")) {
    n_distinct(trajectory_marker_table$gene)
  } else {
    NA_integer_
  },
  significant_curated_trajectory_markers = if (
    exists("significant_curated_trajectory_markers")
  ) {
    nrow(significant_curated_trajectory_markers)
  } else {
    NA_integer_
  },
  used_existing_seurat_umap = use_existing_seurat_umap &&
    !is.na(seurat_umap),
  learn_graph_use_partition = learn_graph_use_partition,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

write_csv(
  trajectory_parameters,
  file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_analysis_parameters.csv")
)

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  file.path(tables_dir, "Monocle3_sessionInfo.txt")
)

cat("Monocle 3 bulk trajectory workflow complete.\n")
cat("Objects:", objects_dir, "\n")
cat("Plots:", plots_dir, "\n")
cat("Tables:", tables_dir, "\n")
```
